definitions.explanation: The maximum point or degree beyond which something cannot go.

examples.japanese: {我慢|がまん}にも{限度|げんど}がある。
{借入|かりいれ}の{限度額|げんどがく}を{超|こ}えてしまった。
この{冗談|じょうだん}はいくらなんでも{限度|げんど}を{超|こ}えている。
examples.english: This joke has gone too far, no matter how you look at it.

notes:
{限度|げんど} refers to a limit or boundary that should not be exceeded. It emphasizes the maximum extent of something.

Common collocations:
- {限度|げんど}がある (there is a limit)
- {限度|げんど}を{超|こ}える (to exceed the limit)
- {限度額|げんどがく} (credit limit, maximum amount)
- {制限|せいげん}{限度|げんど} (restriction limit)

Similar words:
- {限界|げんかい} - limit (often physical/psychological breaking point)
- {制限|せいげん} - restriction (often imposed by rules)
- {上限|じょうげん} - upper limit
- {下限|かげん} - lower limit
